```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(kableExtra)
```


```{r}
# Read in coral data
reef_data <- read_csv("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Coral_cover_lit_review/coral_reef_timeseries_averaged.csv")
corals_extent <- read_csv(here("_habitats", "HAB_corals", "CRL_outputs", "corals_extent.csv"))

# Filter for region 4 data
reef_region4 <- reef_data %>% 
  filter(rgn_id == "Region_4")
# Filter for region 9 data
reef_region9 <- reef_data %>% 
  filter(rgn_id == "Region_9")
```

## Region 4 Time series (alll sites)
```{r}
# Make time series for region 4 data
ggplot(reef_region4, aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = reef_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Reef",
    title = "Time series of coral cover at common sites (Region 4)"
  )

```

```{r}
# make sure year is numeric and factors are set
reef_region4 <- reef_region4 %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    reef_name = factor(reef_name),
    rgn_id = factor(rgn_id)
  )
```

```{r}
# Filter Region 4 for Cabo Pulmo only
cabo <- reef_region4 %>% 
  filter(reef_name == "Cabo Pulmo")

# Split into two time periods
cabo_1991_2012 <- cabo %>% filter(year >= 1991, year <= 2012)
cabo_2013_2023 <- cabo %>% filter(year >= 2013, year <= 2023)

# Calculate averages for each period
avg_1991_2012 <- mean(cabo_1991_2012$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_2013_2023 <- mean(cabo_2013_2023$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# Plot the cabo pulmo time series with 2 periods

# Create a data frame for mean lines so they appear in the legend
mean_df <- data.frame(
  period = c("Mean 1991–2012", "Mean 2013–2023"),
  mean_value = c(avg_1991_2012, avg_2013_2023)
)

my_colors <- c(
  "1991–2012" = "blue",
  "2013–2023" = "orange",
  "Mean 1991–2012" = "blue",
  "Mean 2013–2023" = "orange"
)


ggplot() +
  # Time series 1991–2012
  geom_line(data = cabo_1991_2012,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = cabo_1991_2012,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Time series 2013–2023
  geom_line(data = cabo_2013_2023,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = cabo_2013_2023,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Mean lines
  geom_hline(data = mean_df,
             aes(yintercept = mean_value, color = period),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.55) +
  
  # Mean value labels (left side)
  geom_text(data = mean_df,
            aes(x = min(cabo_1991_2012$year), y = mean_value,
                label = paste0(round(mean_value, 1), "%"), color = period),
            hjust = 1.8, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Time Period",
    title = "Cabo Pulmo Coral Cover Trends: 1991–2012 vs. 2013–2023",
    caption = "Figure 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 40)
  )
```



# Region 9
```{r}
# Remove sites that only have 1 year of data
reef_region9_clean <- reef_region9 %>%
  filter(!reef_name %in% c(
    "Las Iglesias (Bahía Banderas)",
    "Yelapa (Bahía Banderas)",
    "El Paredón (Bahía Banderas)",
    "Caletitas (Bahía Banderas)"
  ))
```


```{r}
# Make time series for region 9 data
ggplot(reef_region9_clean, aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = reef_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2013, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Reef",
    title = "Time Series of Percent Coral Cover in (Region 9)",
    caption = "Figure 2"
  )
```

## Curent Status Calculation
```{r}
# Region 4

# Filter reef data for Region 4 (Cabo Pulmo only)
reef_region4_cabo <- reef_region4 %>%
  filter(reef_name == "Cabo Pulmo")

# Split periods
reef4_pre  <- reef_region4_cabo %>% filter(year < 2013)
reef4_post <- reef_region4_cabo %>% filter(year >= 2013)

# Means
avg_1991_2012 <- mean(reef4_pre$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_2013_2023 <- mean(reef4_post$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)

# Condition score
region4_condition_score <- (avg_2013_2023 / avg_1991_2012)

# Build Region 4 row (NO hard‑coding area)
region4_condition <- tibble(
  rgn_id = "Region_4",
  year = 2025,
  current_status = region4_condition_score
) %>%
  left_join(corals_extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  select(rgn_id, area_km2, year, current_status)
```



```{r}
# Region 9

reef_region9_avg <- reef_region9_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    percent_coral_cover = mean(percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    rgn_id = first(rgn_id)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

# Only include sites that have multiple observations
reef_region9_two <- reef_region9_clean %>%
  filter(reef_name %in% c(
    "Punta Mita (Bahía Banderas)",
    "Isla María Cleofas (Nayarit offshore)",
    "Islas Marietas"
  ))

# Make Region 9 reefs into a single site by averaging percent cover for years with multiple observations.
reef_region9_avg <- reef_region9_two %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    percent_coral_cover = mean(percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    rgn_id = first(rgn_id)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)


reef9_pre  <- reef_region9_avg %>% filter(year < 2013)
reef9_post <- reef_region9_avg %>% filter(year >= 2013)

mean_pre  <- mean(reef9_pre$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_post <- mean(reef9_post$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)

region9_condition_score <- (mean_post / mean_pre)

region9_condition <- tibble(
  rgn_id = "Region_9",
  year = 2025,
  current_status = region9_condition_score
) %>%
  left_join(corals_extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  select(rgn_id, area_km2, year, current_status)
```

```{r}
# Combine region 4 and 9 data
coral_condition_combined <- bind_rows(
  region4_condition,
  region9_condition
)
```

```{r}
# Make a table
coral_condition_combined %>%
  select(rgn_id, area_km2, year, current_status) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c(
      "Region ID",
      "Area (km²)",
      "Year",
      "Current Status (%)"
    ),
    align = c("c", "r", "c", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c("Coral Current Status (2025)" = 4)
  )

```

```{r}
# Select necessary columns
coral_condition_combined <- coral_condition_combined |>
  select(rgn_id, year, current_status)
```

```{r}
# Current Status (SOF_2025 / SOF_2007)
write.csv(
  coral_condition_combined,
  "CRL_outputs/coral_current_status.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Prepare coral condition data for join
coral_condition_map <- coral_condition_combined %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub(" ", "_", rgn_id),
    current_status_int = round(current_status, 0),

    # Categorize into meaningful bins
    status_cat = case_when(
      current_status_int >= 80 ~ "Good (80–100)",
      current_status_int >= 60 ~ "Moderate (60–79)",
      current_status_int >= 40 ~ "Fair (40–59)",
      TRUE ~ "Poor (0–39)"
    )
  )

# Join onto OHI polygons
ohi_coral_condition <- ohi_regions %>%
  left_join(coral_condition_map, by = "rgn_id")

# Split marine vs land
ohi_marine <- ohi_coral_condition %>% filter(location == "marine")
ohi_land   <- ohi_coral_condition %>% filter(location == "land")

# Custom colors
status_colors <- c(
  "Good (80–100)" = "#1a9850",      # green
  "Moderate (60–79)" = "#fee08b",  # yellow
  "Fair (40–59)" = "#fdae61",      # orange
  "Poor (0–39)" = "#d73027"        # red
)

# Plot
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(ohi_land) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(ohi_marine) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "status_cat",
    palette = status_colors,
    alpha = 0.85,
    title = "Coral Current Status (2025)",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title = "Coral Current Status (2025)",
  frame = FALSE,
  legend.outside = TRUE
)


```
